line: Crowley's Seven of Disks is the card for the third decan of Taurus, with Saturn as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Taurus.

quotes.quote: The Seven of Disks is called Failure.
made worse by the influence of Saturn in Taurus

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: The disks themselves are the leaden disks of Saturn.
